mechanisms.name: Object-labeled sign-pair frequency learning is a supervised pattern classifier
mechanisms.observed_mechanism: WC01 stores occurrences and relation counts under caller-supplied thing_id. Each relation contains source/target lane and signs. Learning increments one count per observed relation, requires at least two occurrences, applies L6 count thresholds and subtracts relations shared by multiple object classes. Query thresholds the surviving matches and returns resolved/ambiguous/unknown object identities.
mechanisms.evidence_limits: This is software pattern learning with labeled classes and frequency-based feature selection. It is not implemented contact-yield plasticity, native acquired vocal control or a no-learning algorithm. Determinism, hashes and absence of an ML library do not change that classification. No present invocation is established.
mechanisms.replacement: Remove this classifier from pupil cognitive authority and any no-ML/full-physics capability claim. Preserve forensic evidence; qualify the approved actual native local adaptation and later retained-state consumer instead. Do not port these tables/counters into Rust and rename them physical memory.
